verdict.rationale: Grafana's OpenTelemetry docs say it collects metrics, logs, traces, and profiles while "protecting you from vendor lock-in and ensuring data portability" (grafana-docs-38). Tempo accepts open tracing protocols including OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, and Zipkin (grafana-docs-37). Grafana also queries telemetry "wherever it's stored" (grafana-docs-9), which together supports instrumenting once on open standards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of switching backends without re-instrumenting, detail on OTLP ingestion for metrics and logs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
